ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 9 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

The pronoun «я» (ya, 'I') used as a noun is rendered 'the “I”' (spiritual, animal, all-embracing, universal “I”) rather than 'self'; «познание» (poznaniye) is 'knowing'. The three Gospel lines are translated from Tolstoy's Russian (Luke 22:42, Mark 14:36, Matthew 26:39), and Amiel's «сотни лет» (sotni let) is 'hundreds of years', which the website draft had reduced to 'a hundred'.
